patch_description: This version keeps direct-link rewards but uses a more conservative, concave reward for useful two-hop paths, discounted when the intermediate node has high incident demand. It also adds a small reciprocal-link penalty when traffic is strongly one-sided, discouraging unproductive two-cycles without penalising balanced traffic. The stronger evaluator-supplied degree penalty is intended to reduce invalid samples before repair. All terms are derived deterministically from the demand matrix; the quadratic-term count remains within the required bound.
